name: Browse topics and see the public library on mobile
covers: featured Apostle Anthony Ngugi Mburu section
blue purple white luminous green visual theme
description: Public visitors can explore topics without authentication, including before the first teaching is published.
steps: Open the home page without signing in
Select Categories or Topics
Choose Faith & Victory
Review Browse messages and category selection
Check the home page feature for Apostle Anthony Ngugi Mburu
expected: The Faith & Victory topic is selected, the browse view is available, and either published content or an accurate empty-library message is displayed. The home page features Apostle Anthony Ngugi Mburu in a blue/purple themed section.

name: Search, format filters, and personal saved messages
description: Visitors can search published content and saved messages are local to their browser.
steps: Open Browse
Enter a search word
Change the format to Audio
Open My Library
Return to Browse
expected: Search and format filters update the results without errors, while My Library shows bookmarked media or the saved-library empty state.

name: Deny unauthorized admin dashboard access
description: A public visitor cannot manage or publish library content without an allowlisted account.
steps: Open Admin Portal from the header without an admin sign-in
Review the restricted-access page
Try to proceed without an approved administrator identity
expected: The upload and management dashboard is not available to anonymous visitors or unauthorized identities. A secure administrator sign-in prompt is shown.

name: Create, publish, edit and remove a teaching as an authorized admin
description: Approved admins can manage persistent media metadata and publication states.
steps: Sign in with an approved administrator email
Open Upload Content and create an Article called Test Devotional with a description
Save it as a draft and check that it does not appear publicly
Edit it and enable Publish now
Check that Test Devotional appears in the public library
Return to admin, delete the content and accept confirmation
expected: Draft content remains private, publishing makes it visible to visitors, and a confirmed deletion removes it from the public list after refresh.

name: Upload a supported file and reject invalid media submissions
description: Approved admins can upload small media files while large files must be supplied as externally hosted HTTPS links.
steps: Sign in as an approved administrator
Start a new Audio message and enter a title but no URL or file
Confirm saving shows a validation warning
Select a small MP3 file under 3.5 MB and publish
Open the published message from the public library
expected: The invalid entry is rejected, the supported uploaded file is linked to a published message, and the visitor can open its media player.

name: Display six USD monthly subscription tiers correctly
covers: six paid and free membership choices
description: Confirm updated membership tiers are correctly shown and the Free plan still limits access to three audio teachings and two videos.
steps: Open the member Subscription page
Check Free $0, Growth $5, Faith $10, Faith Plus $15, Kingdom $30 and Sonship $50 per month
Check Free access policy
Verify no live charges can start without a configured checkout
expected: Six plans display correct USD monthly amounts. The Free quota remains three audios and two videos; checkout is disabled until the Stripe integration is deployed and verified.

name: Member registration, profile photo, account menu and theme preferences
description: A signed-in member can open the top-right account menu, edit a display name, upload a profile picture and change theme settings.
steps: Open My Account and choose Register / Sign in
Complete the supported AppDeploy authentication flow
Open Profile and change the display name
Upload a valid JPG, PNG or WebP profile photo under 1.4 MB
Save the profile and refresh the page
Choose dark or light theme, then open Watch History and Watchlist
expected: The signed-in profile name and photo persist, theme preference is stored, and watch history/watchlist pages render without exposing another user's data.

name: Admin settings, section visibility, logo and member management
description: The owner can update the public brand, control visible sections, upload a logo, manage member status and approve or revoke additional administrators.
steps: Sign in using the owner account and open the Admin Portal
Open Extended Admin Controls and change a heading, announcement and brand colour
Toggle a visible library section and save
Upload a supported logo image
Open Members and suspend then reactivate a test member
Open Admin Approvals and approve then revoke a test administrator
expected: Public settings and section visibility update, uploaded branding is stored persistently, member status changes are reflected, and only the owner can approve or revoke admin access.

name: Premium media access, audience pages and download permissions
covers: free plan limit of three distinct audios and two distinct videos
description: Administrators can assign content to Everyday Solutions, Teenager, Youths or Kids/Sunday School and define Free/Premium access and download eligibility.
steps: Sign in as an approved administrator
Create a test audio teaching for Kids / Sunday School
Set access to Premium and turn downloads off
Publish the item and confirm it appears in the Kids collection
Sign in as a Free member and try to open the premium item
Open three distinct free audio teachings and attempt a fourth
Open two distinct free videos and attempt a third
expected: Audience content appears in the selected section, premium items are blocked for Free members, distinct Free access is limited to three audios and two videos, and download links appear only when allowed.

name: Like, share, comment and moderated community interactions
description: Signed-in members can like, save, share and comment on published teachings while new comments remain pending until approved by an administrator.
steps: Open a published teaching and sign in if prompted
Like the teaching and save it to My Library
Use Share to share or copy the message details
Submit a respectful comment
Open the admin Comments tab and approve the submitted comment
Return to the teaching and verify the approved comment is visible
expected: Like and saved state persist to the member profile, sharing is available, comments are stored pending review, and only approved comments are publicly displayed.

name: Subscription request workflow keeps payment activation secure
covers: Free plan audio and video limits
Stripe billing disabled until secure webhook setup
description: Members see all six monthly USD tiers and can submit a plan request without the app claiming that payment has been collected or verified.
steps: Open My Account and Subscription
Review Free $0, Growth $5, Faith $10, Faith Plus $15, Kingdom $30 and Sonship $50 per month
Submit an upgrade request
Open admin Subscriptions and review the pending request
Try to activate a request without a verified Stripe payment
expected: The six correct USD prices are displayed, the request is recorded as pending, and paid access cannot be activated through a manual approval while Stripe webhook verification is not deployed.
